description: A hot little room with two ports cut into the auditorium. At the left port, an enormous cast-iron projector, oiled and threaded. The right-hand one was stripped for parts and now holds a kettle. Between them, on a milk crate, a plastic tape player wired into the house feed. A rewind bench runs under the ports with an open ledger and a pencil.
name: Reel Estate — The Projection Box
